title: Supreme Court seeks CJP response on plea to denotify Ramlila Maidan as protest site

ai.summary: The Supreme Court asked political parties, the Centre, Delhi government and police to respond to traders' plea to remove Ramlila Maidan as a protest site, citing business disruptions during festival season.

facts.claim: traders' plea to denotify Ramlila Maidan as a protest site
facts.quote: The Supreme Court sought responses from political parties, the Centre, Delhi government and police on traders’ plea to denotify Ramlila Maidan as a protest site, citing business disruptions.

facts.claim: court will hear the matter on November 27
facts.quote: The court will hear the matter on November 27

facts.claim: traders argued designated protest sites could not be occupied for all times to come
facts.quote: During the festival season, the traders’ bodies had sought a halt to protests at Ramlila Maidan in central Delhi, arguing that designated protest sites could not be occupied “for all times to come”.

facts.claim: bench issued notices to Centre, Delhi government and Delhi Police Commissioner
facts.quote: The bench also issued notices to the Centre, the Delhi government and the Delhi Police Commissioner.

facts.claim: court said competing fundamental rights must be balanced
facts.quote: It also said that competing fundamental rights — the right to protest and the right to conduct business — must be balanced.

ai.background_note: The Supreme Court is balancing the right to protest and business rights amid festival season disruptions at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi.
